supersedes_reason: v5 passed token_budget=10 into packing for token_boundary, but its result inspector still checked rows against budget 6. v5 outputs are retained; the v6 runner carries the same per-case budget through both production class and invariant check.

contract.fixed_count: Every emitted microbatch has exactly 4 rows, no rollout is split, and any rejected rows are counted only as complete rollouts.
contract.token_budget: Every emitted microbatch is nonempty on both ranks and respects the per-case token budget. Every group is emitted once in one batch or rejected wholly with its row count recorded; exact-fit T is retained.

success_rule: Base violates group integrity on fixed_boundary/token_boundary. Candidate passes all 8 cases, including exact fixed size, exact-fit T retention, whole-group drops with complete drop-row accounting, and correct per-case token caps.
rejection_rule: Partial or split groups; unaccounted/duplicate rows; underfilled fixed batch; empty token rank; violated per-row budget; exact-fit T rejected; or token_boundary groups rejected.

method.execution: AST-extract only _balance_by_squared_length and the pinned FixedCountBatcher/TokenBudgetBatcher definitions.
